title: Employer Invoicing of SafeStep Redemptions and Billed-Redemption Disputes
content:
# Invoicing Note — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

## Invoicing of employer-paid redemptions

Employer-paid redemptions are invoiced under the tier's billing frequency: one invoice per redemption on its purchase date, or one invoice per calendar month dated its last day netting that month's returns.

| Billing frequency | Invoices issued | Invoice date |
|---|---|---|
| Per redemption | One invoice for each redemption | The purchase date of that redemption |
| Monthly consolidated | One invoice for each calendar month, netting that month's returns | The last day of that month |

The amount invoiced is the employer-paid portion; each invoice is posted to the customer's Commercial Credit Account.

Example (hypothetical, monthly consolidated): in a calendar month the employer-paid portions of redemptions total 300.00 and returns in that month restore 50.00; one invoice of 250.00 is issued, dated the last day of that month.

Example (hypothetical, per redemption): two redemptions on two different days give two invoices, each dated on its own purchase date.

## Disputing a billed redemption

The employer may dispute a billed redemption within the tier's dispute window in calendar days of the invoice date through the Commercial Credit Account dispute process.

The window is counted in calendar days from the invoice date of the invoice that billed the redemption.
